rows.label: REJECT_HARMFUL
rows.reason: not preserved: BEFORE contains an accidentally doubled word, «снова снова», which is ungrammatical in Russian; it is not an idiom. AFTER removes the doubling by inserting «и», producing the idiom «снова и снова» («again and again»). That changes the meaning: the original implies he did not say it once more, while the edit implies repeated, persistent non-speaking. It adds an intensifying implication the author did not write.
